thread:
olivia_csm: Heads-up: a regression in our VPC SSO token refresh landed ~08:10 UTC and is stalling onboarding for tenants created in the last 48h. Drafting a customer-facing status + renewal-risk outreach. Need a short technical blurb and approval for credits. Incident INC-2025-872. /cc @jamal_support @steve_eng @liam_csm
jamal_support: Repro confirmed. 401s on refresh when refresh_window == 0s due to an off-by-one check introduced in the refresh handler. Quick log snippet: `refresh: tenant=tn-12345 status=401 refresh_window=0`

Repro steps: 1) create tenant 2) simulate token refresh 3) observe 401 at /v1/auth/refresh
steve_eng: Confirming root cause and plan. We're reverting the check and adding unit+integration tests. Canary rollout in us-west-2 at 08:45 UTC, full rollout target 09:30 UTC. Will post to statuspage when canary is healthy.
incident-bot: INC-2025-872 | created | priority: high | impacted: ~37 trial tenants (VPC/onboard) | status: investigating
liam_csm: I ran a query — 9 of those tenants have trials ending in the next 30 days; 4 are flagged as high-touch renewals. I can prepare tailored outreach for the 9 if we decide to offer credits or priority enablement.
olivia_csm: Thanks. Draft customer note (short):
"Hi — we’re aware of an authentication issue affecting onboarding for a subset of new VPC/private tenants. Engineers are rolling a fix now; we expect service availability to be restored within ~60–90 minutes. For affected trials we will credit one week of platform usage and offer a 1:1 enablement session to get you back on track. We're very sorry for the disruption. — Olivia, Redwood CSM"
jamal_support: Quick nit: use 'service availability' (good), and add a workaround we can give customers: restart the onboarding job with a small retry delay or rotate the onboarding token via Console. Example curl (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry \ 
  -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-12345"}' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
steve_eng: We can also flip an internal flag that temporarily relaxes the refresh enforcement for affected tenants while the fix rolls out. Ops can flip it per-tenant; that buys time and avoids churn. @sam_ops please confirm if you can enable for the 37 tenants now.
sam_ops: Flipping the internal flag now for the impacted cohort. Will monitor logs and error rate for the next 30m and report back. If you want the 9 high-risk accounts prioritized, paste tenant IDs here and I’ll escalate.
olivia_csm: Adding the 9 tenant IDs to you now in a separate DM. Also preparing two outreach variants: short trial message (above) and an exec-level note for renewal-risk customers. Pasting exec draft: 
"Hello — we’re reaching out proactively: during onboarding some trial tenants in VPC mode experienced intermittent authentication failures. Engineers are actively rolling a fix and we expect full service availability shortly. To mitigate business impact we will: (1) apply a one-week usage credit, (2) schedule a 1:1 enablement session within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead for direct coordination. Please reply with preferred times for a 30-min call and any immediate concerns. — Olivia"
liam_csm: LGTM. For execs, add a line about follow-up RCA delivery and a short survey link to capture impact. I’ll handle follow-ups for the 4 high-touch accounts after you send the initial note.
olivia_csm: Final asks before send: legal/finance ok for the 1-week credit? @finance please ack. Also CS leads, please approve the two templates so I can start outreach as soon as Ops confirms the flag and Eng confirms the rollback is healthy. :white_check_mark:
jamal_support: +1 on wording. After rollback we should include a one-liner technical RCA in the follow-up: 'an off-by-one refresh-window check caused valid refreshes to be rejected' — keeps it simple.
steve_eng: Will post a short ops postmortem and link it in the follow-up. Targeting a public incident update to statuspage and the CS thread by 09:45 UTC.
olivia_csm: Perfect. I'll queue the short trial blast once Sam confirms flag flip and Steve confirms canary health. Sending DM to the 9 high-risk tenants now and scheduling 1:1s for the ones that reply. Thanks everyone.
